- Add template profiles with target-specific layouts for improved content customization
- Implement free trial page and comprehensive Pro trial system with expiry UX
- Add AI comparison block and enhanced AI positioning features
- Implement Team draft workflow for improved collaboration
- Add billing checkout support with enterprise pricing per seat model
- Implement full pino logging system for better application monitoring
- Add changelog management and widget customization capabilities
- Update navigation with pricing link for improved user experience

### 🔧 Improvements

- Raise Team tier limit to 250 projects from previous limits
- Increase Pro tier limit to 100 projects for enhanced capacity
- Harden release flow processes for improved deployment reliability
- Enhance documentation with template profile details and examples
- Refresh documentation and legal content for latest version

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Harden team workflow continuity and improve tier consistency
- Align tier limits and gate team publishers for proper access control
- Adjust pricing structure with Team plans at per seat per month and Enterprise back to custom contact sales

- Merge dependabot updates for security and stability improvements
- Bump multiple GitHub Actions to latest versions including checkout, setup-node, and docker actions
- Update development dependencies in minor-and-patch group

## v1.9.0 — 2026-03-19

This release introduces significant new capabilities, including template profiles with target-specific layouts, an AI comparison block, and a new Team draft workflow. We've also enhanced our trial offerings with dedicated free trial pages and Pro trials, alongside improvements to the trial expiry user experience. Key fixes address team workflow continuity, tier consistency, and a refinement of pricing models. Furthermore, project limits for Pro and Team tiers have been increased, and underlying development dependencies have been updated for improved stability and performance.

### ✨ Features

- Added a dedicated free trial page and updated navigation to include a pricing link.
- Introduced template profiles and support for target-specific layouts.
- Implemented an AI comparison block, launched Pro trials, and introduced a Team draft workflow.
- Added support for billing checkout and integrated full Pino logging for enhanced observability.

### 🔧 Improvements

- Increased project limits for the Pro tier to 100 and the Team tier to 250, alongside sharpening AI positioning.
- Enhanced the trial expiry user experience.
- Enhanced v1.9.0 release notes with template profile details and examples, and refreshed general documentation and legal information.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Hardened team workflow continuity and improved tier consistency.
- Aligned tier limits, gated team publishers, and added changelog management with widget customization.
- Corrected pricing models, setting the Team tier to `/seat/mo` and the Enterprise tier back to `Custom/Contact Sales`.

### 🧹 Chores

- Updated various development and build dependencies, including `pnpm/action-setup`, `actions/checkout`, `docker/build-push-action`, `actions/setup-node`, and `docker/setup-buildx-action`.
- Hardened the internal release flow for improved stability.
